name: Help! I Got Married to My Mortal Enemy!
original_name: 救命，我怎么和死对头领证啦
overview: 25-year-old jewelry designer Deng Qianqian and her rival Zhou Yu had a drunken relationship by accident. They were bumped into by their parents and forced to get married. The two had a feud for twenty years because she accidentally killed his bird when she was six years old. Deng Qianqian hid in a resort hotel to escape from marriage. Little did she know that Zhou Yu had been secretly in love with her for many years, and it was inevitable to pursue his wife in a sinister manner. Deng Qianqian, whose card was frozen, was forced to serve Zhou Yu personally in exchange for money. Zhou Yu's preference gradually melted her prejudices. After the marriage, she encounters a wild boar while camping. Her love rival Shang Yulin's self-protection and Zhou Yu's sacrifice to protect each other completely unlock the crux of the matter. From tit-for-tat to affectionate confessions, the two finally held a wedding with everyone's blessings and gained a perfect love.
